decisions.reason: The anamnesis and consent app is the flagship product line, close to the core offer and aligned with the digitalization trend in German dental practices, so keeping this option open costs little and its upside remains substantial.
The analytics dashboard builds on existing practice data at low marginal cost and supports the firm's direction toward efficiently managed practices, so it is worth keeping while its value resolves.
The complete practice bundle mainly repackages core modules for new practices, so it costs little to maintain and keeps open an acquisition channel for new customers.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core offer and was only mentioned on the website, so its value is still uncertain, but a lightweight portal is cheap to keep and could strengthen community ties.
